rca_of_issue: Root cause: Posts stored user_avatar at creation time (a snapshot). When user updated their avatar via PUT /api/profile, only the users collection was updated but existing posts still had the old (or empty) user_avatar. Fix: (1) profile.py PUT now calls db.posts.update_many({'user_id': user_id}, {'$set': {'user_avatar': new_avatar}}) and same for community_posts; (2) ProfilePanel.js handleAvatarUpload now immediately calls PUT /api/profile with just {avatar: avatarUrl} after file upload, without requiring user to click 'Save Profile'.
